page.overview:
Who is Hadaji Sakagami?

Sakagami is an elderly man with neatly combed white hair. His eyes are wizened and he has noticeable wrinkles.

Little is known about Sakagami's personality. He appears to be rather resourceful, as his department were responsible for recording the status of the Ear Devil's erasure.

At some point in time, Hadaji Sakagami became the Minister of Internal Affairs of Japan.

Hadaji Sakagami is one of the Japanese Government Officials who had a meeting in order to discuss the potential of erasing the Aging Devil from existence and its affects on the people of Japan.
